# Lubrication and anti-seize application for front CVs

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Apply grease to the C-clip and cover threaded ends with copper or nickel-based anti-seize. [t535]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use SAE GL 80W-90 gear oil for the inner diff side if desired, as it will self-lubricate. [t535]
- [Partial] Copper or nickel-based anti-seize is preferred to prevent binding and rust. [t535]
